policies.egg: Each actual deathrattle summons the explicitly linked next printed form through SummonByCard; no egg counters or inferred suffix lookup. Ordinary source controller, quantities/capacity/entry/death apply.
policies.hardship: Damage.on_result freezes original post-batch target survival. A surviving original gets ordinary Draw even with zero damage prevented by shield. Otherwise InvokeHealthResult checks actual original damage/poison DeathRecord cause.result equality after ordinary deaths; no later same-name or same-ID reentry inference. Exact damage-to-reward/reaction order and redirection remain local M6 policy.
policies.vanessa: card_played completed PlayRecord with exact event source/player; own physical entry excluded; any own actual paid card kind qualifies, including countered hand plays. Prepare, summon and effect casts do not create PlayRecord and do not qualify. Complete collectible Battlecry minion pool; each ordinary generation carries local delta -2 CostSpec. Exact after-play trigger order remains local M6 policy.
policies.tax: Own pending PlayerEffectSpec copies TIME_716 pending_slow declarative trigger, with own source card identity; reuses existing activate_slow behavior. Opponent next actual turn_started accepts current-turn +1 CostSpec and retires pending instance, independent of source lifetime. No global turn+1 prediction.
policies.time615_gap: Whole-card deferred: missing pool fill-to-effective-hand-capacity request preserving local expiring Health payment. No guessed default limit, recursive private producer, hard-coded count or partial definition.
